name: TrustDemoDdChwRegistration
title: TD.J2A Newborn registration on a home visit
description: What the community health worker records offline when she finds a newborn missing from the household roster: the registration form's answers and each dose read from a foreign card without verifying it.

mapping.name: Realised in this guide's profiles and examples
mapping.comment: Where this guide realises each element: a profile or example path, a DVC payload element (smart.who.int.trust-phw), or a CWT or COSE field.

element.short: TD.J2A Newborn registration on a home visit
element.definition: What the community health worker records offline when she finds a newborn missing from the household roster: the registration form's answers and each dose read from a foreign card without verifying it.
The household on the CHW's roster that the child joins.
The child's given name.
The child's family name.
The child's date of birth.
The country the child was born in, when abroad.
Whether the family holds vaccination cards from abroad.
The id the child carries until civil registration catches up.
The community health worker who registered the child.
When the registration was captured, on the phone, possibly offline.
The family member who gave the answers.

code.display: Dose read from a foreign card

element.short: Dose read from a foreign card
element.definition: One dose read from a foreign DVC with the unverified triage read (STT-VER-011), saved as reported by the family.
